newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Sydney leads Australian house prices - agents.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Sydney leads Australian house prices - agents.

text.p: Sydney house prices, up 3.4 percent in the year to October from the previous year, have risen faster than those in all other cities, the Real Estate Institute said in a statement on Thursday.
The second fastest rise appeared in Newcastle, whose house prices for the year to October were 2.9 percent higher than the corresponding period of a year before, the institute said.
Melbourne prices were up 2.6 percent on the same basis.
"(The research) indicates that the real estate market across Australia has picked up significantly over 1996," the institute said.
The early-1990s bulding boom had created a considerable oversupply, it said.
"However, by the second half of 1996 most of this excess housing stock had been exhausted and the housing market is now on its way up again."
